answer: A latency-triangulation check: each new identity must answer timed pings from 5 randomly chosen validators in different regions during one 10-minute window, and identities whose round-trip profiles match within 3 ms of an existing one share a single hollow slot of reward weight. Every extra fake identity on the same hardware divides that slot further, so its marginal payout falls as 1/n while hosting costs stay constant. Validators publish signed timing samples, and anyone can recompute the echo-time clustering. A steady pulse of re-tests every 20 epochs catches drift.
